items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: The original Dixieland jazz band, he can vouch for it is Nick LaRocca on, Jack and Abbey.

ctx.x: You think they're named from New Orleans? I don't know. I've heard all different stories, but I never did know. That's right.

The original Dixieland jazz band, he can vouch for it is Nick LaRocca on, Jack and Abbey. He don't like to talk to nobody about nothing the way I understand. They went up there and they had a dance called a shimmy. And dancing around the Shilla Cafe, they used to call it ass dance, jazz. They called it jazz dance. And they called it first J-A-Z, then J-A-S, then J-A-S, then J-A-S, then J-A-Z. And they were the name originally. Harry James could tell you that today if he's living, I believe it's down in the French…
From the Chicago movement? That's right. That's right.
